# اِسْتَرْأَلْتِ (istarʔalti) /is.tar.ʔal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرْأَلَ (istarʔala)
# اِسْتَرْأَلَتْ (istarʔalat) /is.t
